items.text: We're introducing six new scenarios for the Fly Corp Delivery DLC! It’s been almost half a year since this expansion was released, and it has performed quite well. We’ve decided to continue supporting not only the base game but also this DLC. Each of the new scenarios features unique gameplay situations and has its own victory conditions. In one, you must build a certain number of warehouses; in another, deliver a million packages; and in a third, the key to victory is quickly sorting out rival companies’ warehouses.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/d215765cd5237eab4abea930397cf8f33e86bb63.jpg"]
We may also release a user-created scenario editor for this expansion soon.
Fixed a bug that prevented the camera from switching to a full warehouse after clicking on a notification in free play.
Fixed a bug where the warehouse icon could remain marked with an exclamation point even if the warehouse was connected to the network.

Fixed the condition for clearing a competitor’s warehouse: it is now considered cleared when the vehicle carrying the last shipment on its route from that warehouse has zero packages remaining - when it has unloaded everything. Packages do not necessarily have to reach their final destination until the timer ends; it is sufficient to unload everything into their respective warehouses.
Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented the game from disabling the speed boost during the countdown.

Fixed the placement of some cities in the main game.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/6985ba37b5ec6c6e040123c05aa784d07bc394f5.png"]: At the same time, we’ve been quietly working on a full refactor of the main game for several months now. As we mentioned earlier, this is an important step to clean up the project’s code so that it will be easier to maintain in the future. We’re also exploring ways to improve and update the user interface.: Thank you for playing Fly Corp!: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/41980fd17b5950c49ff4ed60cdf4dc26545a1a7d.jpg"]: Do you like the update? Please let us know your feedback about it. It's important for us to hear your opinion! You can participate in discussions about game updates on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/9eHyYap
We’re a little late in announcing it, but we’ve released a new game update. It fixes known issues.
Updated daily scenarios #42, 53, 63, 72, and 75, which players had reported issues with;
Fixed a critical bug causing the game to freeze in the Delivery DLC;
Fixed a bug that caused issues with player interaction with the UI while the game was paused;
Fixed a bug in the Delivery DLC that prevented a competitor’s warehouse from being fully dismantled during an event where one of the destination warehouses was blocked;
Fixed a bug that could break automatic aircraft routing on a route after a warehouse block event;
Fixed a bug where the route’s end point could be visually set next to a warehouse instead of on it;
Fixed a bug where the warehouse pop-up would flash when hovering over the name of another warehouse;
Added the following languages to the Delivery DLC: Arabic, Korean, Portuguese (Portugal), Spanish (Latin America), Turkish, Vietnamese, Japanese;
Fixed an issue where it was possible to switch to windowed mode from the Delivery DLC settings;
The Syrian city of An-Nabek has been renamed to Al-Haditha and moved to its correct location;

Cities with zero population now have a population of 50 to prevent an error when placing a warehouse near such cities.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/be1d2cd08fbd0e5405f4ed351e7480ce7cf5ad02.jpg"]: Do you like the update? Please let us know your feedback about it. It's important for us to hear your opinion! You can participate in discussions about game updates on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/9eHyYap

The biggest new feature in this latest game update is the addition of competitor warehouses in the Delivery DLC. Every 10 minutes, a warehouse belonging to a bankrupt parcel delivery company will appear at random locations. Your task is to send all the packages left in the warehouse within 5 minutes. In other words, packages in these warehouses are generated only when the warehouse appears, and no new ones appear. If you manage to clear the warehouse, you’ll receive a generous reward and refund for all routes and planes connected to that warehouse. However, keep in mind that there are quite a lot of packages, and they create an additional load on your network. Is it worth taking the risk for the sake of an extra reward? It’s up to you!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/6a800768d1eec62091fad592bb24d7d9c3275e2e.jpg"]
Fixed the total number of territories displayed on the game statistics screen. It is now 201 everywhere
French Guiana now unlocks with a city - its administrative center
Added the “completed without saves” bonus to the statistics screen if the player only saved but did not load that game
Fixed a bug where exiting ladder mode in the American Dream DLC would take you to the ladder mode screen of the main game
Fixed a bug where the “completed” marker for a scenario would disappear after switching between scenario pages
Fixed several interface bugs in the Delivery DLC
Fixed a bug in the Delivery DLC where the construction mode would open when clicking the speed-up button while the route construction window was open
Fixed a bug in the Delivery DLC that caused an event result to trigger even if the game was paused
Fixed a bug in the Delivery DLC where the game could be resumed from pause in construction mode

The Delivery DLC save files now store the next two countries that are due to appear as destinations (similar to how it works in the main game): [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/b7c86fe35387939e100c7865cb31d421c8aaf34d.png"]: Do you like the update? Please let us know your feedback about it. It's important for us to hear your opinion! You can participate in discussions about game updates on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/9eHyYap
Since we received quite a few bug reports about the newly released Delivery DLC, we decided to focus on it in this new update. There are many changes, and here is the full list:
The Statistics screen has been added to the Delivery DLC
Fixed a bug where some saves from the main game reset city levels to level one
The number of routes from/to one warehouse is now unlimited in Delivery DLC
A restriction has been added to the “Discover the World” mode in the Delivery DLC to prevent large territories from unlocking too early in the game
The exit from the game mode in the Delivery DLC play session has been fixed. Now the exit takes you to the menu of this DLC, rather than to the main game
Fixed a visual bug in the Delivery DLC where warehouse names and customer base numbers were displayed under the borders between territories
Fixed a bug in the Delivery DLC where if a pop-up was open when a random event occurred, it could only be closed with a press of the Esc key
In the Delivery DLC, a bug has been fixed where sometimes when opening the settings window, the elements in it were displayed as semi-transparent and inactive.
In the Delivery DLC, the change in warehouse size when upgrading it with each level is now more noticeable.

In the Delivery DLC, the event with warehouses being blocked due to rats has been adjusted. Now a maximum of 4 warehouses can be blocked, and the blocking time has been reduced to 2 minutes (was 6 minutes before).
In the Delivery DLC, the event with the drivers' strike has been adjusted. Now the number of delivered parcels left in warehouses has been halved.
In the Delivery DLC, the display of leaderboards with a 3:4 aspect ratio has been fixed.
A sound effect has been added when unlocking a territory in the Delivery DLC.
In the Delivery DLC, the option to cancel warehouse construction by clicking the warehouse purchase button for the second time has been added.
In the Delivery DLC, a bug that caused the game to freeze if a random event occurred while the player was plotting a route has been fixed.
Fixed a camera bug in the Delivery DLC that prevented the camera from moving to an overflowing warehouse if another warehouse pop-up window was open at the time of overflow
Added the “Radical Solution” achievement to the Delivery DLC
Added a game over sound to the Delivery DLC
In the Delivery DLC, the camera no longer moves to a new territory each time one is unlocked
In the Delivery DLC, the sale price of the supersonic aircraft from the event is now the same as in the main game (previously, the cost was zero)
In the Delivery DLC, a bug has been fixed where the map scale would change when scrolling with the mouse wheel in the pause menu or settings
In Delivery DLC, a bug that sometimes prevented the pause menu from opening completely has been fixed
Some localization fixes have been made in Delivery DLC
In Delivery DLC, a bug that caused advanced aircraft to cost two to three times more than purchasing level 1 aircraft and then upgrading them has been fixed
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/aac7bb2add5240e3ea6687df54367f0059ed8abd.jpg"]

What's more, in the Delivery DLC, you can quickly bring up the save game dialog by pressing F5 and open the load save dialog by pressing F9. We hope all of this will improve your gaming experience! Thank you for your feedback. It helps us find issues and fix them faster.
This week, patch 1.9.7 was released, which includes the following fixes:
New Year game modes have been removed
The capital of Equatorial Guinea has been renamed
Fixed a bug with the display of percentages when saving a Free game in the American Dream DLC
Corrected the names of some Chinese cities
The city of Salmon River in Idaho is now simply Salmon, as it should be called
Corrected the location of the city of Uelen in Russia
The city of Cape Girardeau has been moved to the state of Missouri, where it should be located
Fixed the name of the city of Blagoveshchensk in Chinese

The city of Faribault, Minnesota can now be unlocked on the user scenario timeline: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/e5a9e04ad791e88ac5cbb60e0ca6b9a988ba39ee.jpg"]: We are already working on the next update.: The beginning of the year is turning out to be very exciting for all Fly Corp fans!: We recently released a demo version of a new game in the series, Deep Corp, and we are confident that all Fly Corp fans will enjoy it, as it features familiar gameplay on the one hand, but also many new mechanics and a different theme on the other. You can try the demo on the game's Steam page—it's already available.: In addition, we will be making another announcement regarding Fly Corp in the coming weeks. But we won't reveal our cards ahead of time. Stay tuned for news! And don't forget that we have a cozy Discord server where we constantly discuss the game and everything related to it: https://discord.com/invite/9eHyYap
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/f44dc5f9e4c3840e3001a875bf54cdc29c11e7fe.png"]

In response to your numerous requests, we have expanded the “Cities of Your Choice” mode by adding a version without timers. This means that you can't lose due to airport overcrowding, you don't need to unlock new territories every 6 minutes, and you can start the game from any territory.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/d2edfb6691225f96bd2c3adb56840883d0f6ab4d.jpg"]
We have reworked the balance of the classic version of the “Cities of Your Choice” mode. Now the cost of unlocking territories does not increase as quickly as before.

We have also added the ability to enable the option for players to choose the city to unlock in the scenario editor. This means you can expect new scenarios with this feature from other players, or try making your own!
Fixed a bug where, at random moments during the game, newly purchased planes would fly out of the city with the green color, even though they had passengers on board.
Fixed a bug where, when loading a save with Ladder mode after playing “Cities of Your Choice”, the city selection button remained.
Fixed the setting for the minimum city population when creating a custom scenario.

Other minor fixes.: Do you like the update? Please let us know your feedback about it. It's important for us to hear your opinion! You can participate in discussions about game updates on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/9eHyYap
We've released update 1.9.2. Most of the changes are about fixing bugs we found.

releases.displayName: Plans for the October game update

items.text: Thank you for the warm reception of the September update, which added a mode where players can choose cities themselves! We carefully read all your feedback and comments and strive to continue improving the game.

We plan to release the next content update in the second half of October. In it, the option to choose cities to include in the game process will be added to “Free Play.” We also want to give players the opportunity to create their own scenarios with similar settings. In other words, a parameter that allows players to select cities will be added to the Scenario Editor.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/7ba227d7dc59bac5590eed339cdd5716c879130b.jpg"]
We wish you a pleasant Fall! It's a great time to spend cozy evenings playing our game.
As always, we look forward to seeing you in our Discord community! There you can get news about our games and discuss game tactics with other players: https://discord.gg/9eHyYap

Meet the 1.9 update! It adds the long-awaited “Cities of your choice” mode to the main game. In it, your task will be to unlock territories for a limited time, but this time it's up to you to choose which cities to bring into the game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/a8bbef2bd39fb9c529b6eb48f72035e130180f2c.jpg"]
Along with this, we have made other changes, including fixing several achievements.
As always, we look forward to seeing you in our Discord community! There you can get news about our games and discuss game tactics with other players: https://discord.gg/9eHyYap

The new monthly mode for the American Dream DLC is called “Cities of your choice”. In it, you will have to choose the cities you want to include in the game. To do this, you need to open a special map mode where all cities available for inclusion in the game are displayed in gray. You can select any of them at any convenient time.
The Great Lakes have been added to the US map in the American Dream DLC
Fixed a bug with the playtime counter
Fixed a bug where upgrading all aircraft on a route did not update their sale price
Fixed a bug where clicking the pause button would start building a route if there was a city under the button at that moment
Now, after completing a stage in Ladder mode in the American Dream DLC, the game exits to the free play menu instead of the main menu
Fixed a bug where selling planes of level 2 and above would give you more money than usual
Made adjustments to the French localization
Fixed some errors in the Korean localization of city names

Added some translations into Spanish, Portuguese, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, and Arabic: We are happy to strive to make the game even better. We hope you enjoy the new monthly mode. As with previous modes, you have a limited time to try it out. However, after a month, we will launch a cycle of monthly game modes from the very beginning. This is a great opportunity to play game modes you may have missed before.

notes.title: Thank you for playing Fly Corp!

items.text: As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish

Another month has passed, which means that we are ready to introduce a new monthly mode for the American Dream DLC. It's called “Popular City”. Its quirk is that all passengers want to fly to one single city. This city is chosen randomly and changes periodically. That means you will have to constantly keep track of the alternating passenger flow.

This mode will be available for a month, and when it is over we plan to publish the next one. However, “Popular City”, as well as the previous monthly game modes, will still return as part of the mode rotation.
Other than that, the update contains minor fixes to both the main game and the DLC.
As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish

The biggest change in this update is related to the American Dream DLC. It now has a new monthly mode “City on Demand”, which has replaced the previous one. The essence of the mode is that in it you can unlock a random city on demand when it is convenient for you. Of course, you won't be able to unlock thousands of cities, as each state has a limit on their number. However, the new method of opening cities transforms the game experience. We plan to replace City on Demand with the next mode in a month.

Today we have published a new patch. The most important change is about the difficulty of the “Discover the World” mode. We listened to your requests to make the start easier. Now the starting balance has been increased from 250 to 500, and passenger traffic grows more smoothly. At the same time, we have slightly decreased the timer of the first new city appearance - instead of three minutes (at the same time as the first random event) now it opens on the second minute.
Fixed some minor UI elements;
Fixed some problems in Korean localization;

Removed the text that told the player to upgrade the city from the news bar when the city is close to overcrowding. This phrase often misinformed new players, because instead of upgrading the airport it is sometimes better to start a new route or buy a new airplane;

Now if you unlock the USA, you can open Portugal.: We would like to remind you that the “American Dream” DLC is in active development. Its release is scheduled for the end of February. But you can add it to your wishlist now!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3285860/Fly_Corp__American_Dream/: Thank you for playing Fly Corp! We are happy to make the game better with every update!

We're announcing the start of the competition for time! Who will unlock all the territories in the “Discover the World” mode with the maximum amount of time left? It is the in-game time that is taken into account, i.e. you can safely pause the game and plan further actions. The main thing is the amount of available time you have at the end of the game. In a month we will summarize the results and publish a table of best records. This game mode is published instead of daily scenarios (don't worry - they will be back, we just decided to diversify the game).

items.text: Allowed uploading custom scenarios without victory conditions to the server

On the eve of the holidays, we decided to give you, our players, a big present! We have made a special game mode “Gift Delivery”. You will have to help Santa to deliver presents from Rovaniemi (Lapland) to cities all over the world. And this time you will control a network of flying reindeer sleighs.
KishMish Games team wishes you happy upcoming holidays! May you have good luck both in the game and in real life!

The main topic of this update is performance improvements. We received a lot of complaints about low game performance and occasional freezes in game sessions with a lot of unlocked cities and running routes. It took us a lot of time to improve pathfinding and passenger generation algorithms, but we managed it. Now the game should be able to handle a large number of routes much easier. If you experienced performance problems before, please let us know how much better the game is on the new version.

Also, important changes have been made to some scenarios. There were some that were too easy or too difficult. Changes have been made to scenarios: Caribbean Islands, Volatile Passenger Flow, Passenger Spike, Domestic Flights.
Fixed a bug where you could get the “Millionaire” achievement by loading two saves, one after another
Now if you load a game that was saved during the city overcrowd timer countdown, the timer value is retained
Speed of camera movement with buttons no longer depends on whether VSync is on or off
Removed erroneous refreshing of the scenario list while adding a scenario to favorites
Fixed a bug where passenger generation would increase if the same save was loaded several times in a row
Fixed a bug where in the Caribbean scenario, the statistics screen showed more territories than were actually unlocked.
Fixed a bug where a city could overflow with just one passenger in Ladder mode
Fixed a bug with “Discover the World” mode freezing when unlocking the final territory

Fixed a bug with the presence of passenger generation in cities that were blocked by an event: We continue to actively work on the game and prepare something new and interesting for you in the near future. Thank you for playing Fly Corp!: As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the newest update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

Previously, for optimization, we used a pathfinding algorithm with an approximate calculation of the optimal route. This means that in complex situations, the algorithm gave close to optimal, but not the most optimal routes. We have long been trying to improve the path search algorithm to increase its accuracy and performance. This is a truly non-trivial task. And now, finally, we have succeeded.
Now passengers should choose the most optimal route from the departure city to the final destination city for transfers. At the same time, you should be able to see improved performance of the game.
Fixed a bug when in some rare cases the statistics screen showed more territories than were actually unlocked
Fixed a bug where passengers could try travelling to a city that was not yet connected

Fixed a problem with city names in the tutorial when switching languages from the pause menu: As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the newest update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

items.text: We have released another small update that improves the quality of the game and fixes some bugs.
Fixed the bug when upgrading an airport from the statistics screen gave twice as few infrastructure points as upgrading it from the map.
Arrows pointing at overcrowded cities (with camera panning to overcrowded cities disabled) have been removed from the Game Over screen.

Fixed the logic of random events in scenarios. Now, if the "Random event trigger interval" is zero, the "First random event time" and "Time before showing message with the consequence of the choice taken in event" parameters are not active and greyed out.

Fixed the timer for events that have a lifespan. Now it indicates the correct time until the next event appears, even if it is called not by the interval, but earlier, by the timeline in the scenario editor
Fixed the bug that caused the pop-up of a city or route to close when a new territory is unlocked

Fixed the assignment of target territories in the "Discover the World" mode. Now territories bordering through the Pacific Ocean will not be considered as neighbors.: As you can see, although we have already started preparing for the next big update, we also do not forget to release patches that improve the quality of the game.: Thank you for playing Fly Corp!: As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss this update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

New balance of the "Discover the World" mode. We tried to make it more enjoyable and interesting. By "more enjoyable" we mean a changed income curve, prices for opening new countries and building routes. In the previous version of the game, the number on the balance is often more than tens and hundreds of millions. In the new one, you will have to operate with smaller numbers, and this is much more convenient.: Along with the rebalance, we completely reset the leaderboards and deleted all saves made in the previous version of this game mode (this is a forced step, since the changes in the balance are too big to be able to load old saves). As a tribute to our loyal players, we leave access to the old leaderboards in the game. So you don't have to worry about your high score going into oblivion.

The option to start the "Discover the World" mode from a random country. Attention! This option is only suitable for experienced players, as the difficulty from the very beginning of the game can be significantly higher due to large territories. For those who are not ready to restart due to randomness, we recommend playing the classic version starting from Germany.

The option to turn off the automatic panning of the camera to a crowded city. Now it is replaced by arrows with a timer; they show in which direction the crowded city is. The option is in the game settings.
The option to turn off messages that the city is almost full. This option will appeal to those who find such messages annoying.

Two new languages ​​​​have been added - Vietnamese and Arabic. And this time, the introduction of a new language turned out to be a very difficult task. After all, in Arabic, the text is written from right to left! Buttons, signatures, numbers - all this shifted, mixed up, and confusion reigned on the screen. We had to change the logic of the interface, edit many elements, manually separate the numbers (after all, unlike the text, they are written from left to right). In general, the amount of work turned out to be much more than we expected. But we hope that our efforts were not in vain, and this will allow native speakers of these two languages ​​to play our game with ease.

New balance of the "Loan payment", "Continents" and "Long distances" scenarios.: The first scenario, in which the balance periodically goes into the negative, was too easy. Now it can be determined as a medium-difficulty scenario. "Long distances" and "Continents" on the contrary were made easier, since in the previous version after rewriting the algorithm for calculating the cost of tickets they were unbeatable. However, these two scenarios still remain quite difficult, as they were originally intended.
Fixed a bug that caused passengers to be generated at a very high rate in some cities after loading a save.
Fixed button overlaps and UI issues at different resolutions.
Fixed a bug where players' score points that were too high could overlap the edge of the user scenario card.
Fixed a bug that prevented the "Active Pause" achievement from being unlocked.
Fixed the display of events on the editor timeline. Previously, if there were too many events, they would stop being displayed.
You can no longer earn achievements in the tutorial.
If you upgrade an overcrowded city while paused, the camera will no longer move to it after you unpause the game.
Removed a small visual bug in the free play progress bar in the dark theme.
Removed a bug that caused the pause button to turn black if you changed the game language while paused.

Other minor fixes.: We continue to work on supporting and improving the game. We will share our plans for future updates soon.: In the meantime, we are waiting for your feedback on the current update. Write what you like and what you don't like. Thank you for playing Fly Corp!: As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss this major update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

releases.displayName: We invite you to the open beta test of a new major update!

items.text: Before releasing the next update, we would like to first know the opinion of players who want to participate in testing. Without exaggeration, this is one of the most important updates this year. There are quite a few changes, but in this post we will dwell in more detail on what we would like to hear your opinion about in the first place.

notes.title: New balance of "Discover the World" and "Free play"

items.text: We completely rebalanced both modes. We did not like the way the cost of tickets was calculated before as it was somewhat chaotic. Now, this value changes smoothly.

Next, a little about how the calculations happen "under the hood". The more territories are unlocked, the more the costs of supporting the infrastructure are. This is reflected in the ticket price. For example, for delivering a passenger from point A to point B, when 1 territory is unlocked, you get a little more than when 10 territories are unlocked. However, in general, due to the constantly increasing passenger flow, you still earn more and more money in total. If we did not change the ticket price, the amount earned would quickly exceed all conceivable limits - hundreds of trillions.
The cost of unlocking new territories and the cost of creating routes at later stages of the game were reduced. Now the numbers are more convenient to operate.

It also became possible to start the run of "Discover the World" from a random territory. This option is more suitable for experienced players, since it is almost always more difficult to play than in a compact European region. But at the start, you are given twice as much money.
Try the new balance and share your opinion. We worked on it for a really long time, and it is important for us to know that our efforts were not in vain.

notes.title: New balance of the "Loan payment" and "Long distances" scenarios

items.text: The first scenario, in which the balance periodically goes into the negative, was too easy. Now it can be classified as a medium-difficulty scenario.

"Long distances" on the contrary was made easier, since in the previous version after rewriting the algorithm for calculating the cost of tickets it was impossible. However, the scenario still remains difficult, as it was originally intended.

If you know one of these languages, we would be grateful if you let us know about any mistakes you notice. However, we tried to make high-quality professional translations and refactored the interface so that the new languages are displayed correctly in the game.

A new version of Fly Corp 1.3.2 has been released on Steam with important bugfixes.

The most important thing is that we discovered a bug due to which, when an active or passive pause was turned on, the “life” timers of cities continued to count down. This meant that the more the player paused the game, the greater the passenger flow in the cities was. Consequently, the difficulty of the game increased significantly. This problem has now been fixed.
Now, after creating your new scenario, you will return to the private scenarios tab, not public ones;
Fixed a bug with the random event effect duration bar not automatically collapsing. The bug occurred when, at the moment of a new event with an effect, this notification was maximized;
Fixed a bug where the bar for the number of passengers at the airport did not correspond to their actual number when the game was paused;
Fixed a bug which sometimes caused connected cities to show as non-connected in Statistics;

Fixed a bug with the disappearance of the passenger list from the city window when it was upgraded during an active pause.: As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

The main change in the new version is a change in the algorithm for calculating the cost of tickets. The fact is that previously it was more profitable to build long routes and send passengers along non-optimal routes. Now, when a passenger lands at their destination, you will always receive income based on the distance between the departure city and the final city (not including transfers). This opens up more opportunities to use a variety of viable tactics when building your transportation network.

The difficulty of the existing scenarios has not changed for the most part. However, we have slightly adjusted the “Discover the World” mode - it has become more difficult when many countries have already been opened (more than 90).
